name: Exsile SMS Gateway
author: Exsile

sections.description:
SMS Leads Gateway (by Exsile Digital) provides a complete solution for sending SMS messages easily on your website when forms are submitted from Elementor Pro, Contact Form 7, Pojo Forms, and WooCommerce.

Get a free trial account

Get an SMS price list

Go to SMS Leads website

  • Works only with Israeli cellular operators.

Developers API

You can read about our API in https://www.smsleads.co.il/api/
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 4.0 or greater
  • PHP version 7.4 or greater
  • MySQL version 5.0 or greater

Installation

  1. Install using the WordPress built-in Plugin installer, or extract the zip file and drop the contents in the wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > SMS Leads.
  4. Enter your account details and choose when to send SMS.
